verdict.rationale: Granola's own features do act across many notes at once: Chat can query all meetings or a whole folder, and a one-click CSV export covers historical notes in bulk. These are read and analysis operations, though, not mutations such as bulk edit, move, tag, delete or re-template. The API's list endpoints are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: bulk edit/move/delete/re-template actions across selected notes, bulk-apply recipes to many notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
You're able to export historical data from Granola by going to Settings, clicking Profile in the sidebar (under Preferences), and clicking Generate CSV
The CSV includes the title, note summary, transcript, and other basic details for each note.
